name: Hellawes

attributes.attribute: attempted unsuccessfully to seduce the great knight Lancelot

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Hellawes is an Arthurian heroine. She was a sorceress. Hellawes tried to seduce the great knight Lancelot. Her attempt failed.

key_results: Record her as an Arthurian heroine and sorceress.
